chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Kuleyb ibn Muawiya al-Saydawi, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Beware of the people! Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, when He intends good for a servant, He marks a spot in his heart, then leaves him, and he wanders around because of it and seeks it.'

Then he said: 'If you were to speak to the people, say to them: We go where Allah goes, and we choose whom Allah chooses, and Allah chose Muhammad, and we chose the Progeny of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'mark in the heart' in Shia theology regarding divine guidance?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises selective engagement with the public, emphasizing that divine favor manifests as an innate spiritual inclination ('nuktah') within the heart. He instructs believers to articulate their allegiance by declaring they follow God’s choice, specifically identifying Prophet Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt as the divinely selected guides, thereby linking personal spiritual state to the theological concept of *Ikhlas* (divine selection).

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Kuleyb Bin Muawiya Al Saydawi who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Beware of the people! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, whenever He<sup>azwj</sup> Intends good with a servant, Imprints a spot in his heart, but He<sup>azwj</sup> Neglects him, and he wanders around due to that and seeks it (the true Religion)’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you all were to speak to the people, say to them, ‘We go where Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send us, and we choose whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chooses (for us), and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chose Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and chose us<sup>asws</sup>, the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Kulayb ibn Mu’awiyah al-Saydawi who has said the following:

“Once abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) said to me, ‘Beware of people.’ If Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, wills good for a servant. He places a dot in his heart. He then leaves him alone and for that reason he moves around and searches it (belief).’

The Imam then said, ‘Were you to talk to people, say we have gone where Allah goes, we choose whoever Allah chooses. Allah chose Muhammad and we chose the family of Muhammad, recipients of divine supreme covenant.’”
